subject: english
question:
**Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the following sentence.**

Aggressive and violent natured people often don’t engage in fruitful arguements.
solution:
The incorrectly spelt word is: **arguements**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling should be "**arguments**"
 
• **Arguments**: An exchange of diverging or opposite views, typically a heated or angry one. (बहस) 
 
 
• For example- *The committee presented strong arguments __against building a new school.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 2, which is incorrectly spelt.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Aggressive**: Showing anger and a willingness to attack other people. (आक्रामक)
 
• **Fruitful**: Producing excellent or helpful results; productive. (फलदायक)
 
• **Natured**: Having a specified type of personality. (स्वभाव)
